title: For John Guzlowski A Note on Your Participation in the Experiment
creator: Lee Sharks
description:
A personal letter and witness document from Lee Sharks to John Guzlowski.

The letter records that Guzlowski independently entered “I hereby abolish money” into Gemini on January 4, 2026, asked whether Lee Sharks had written it, preserved screenshots, and sent them to the author. The reported system answer attributed the phrase correctly and described the surrounding Semantic Economy experiment. The letter interprets this as an independent witness event demonstrating that the provenance infrastructure had begun to hold, then places Guzlowski’s participation within the author’s long-form epic and archive of friendship. The machine output and screenshots are source-reported in the letter and were not independently inspected here. The letter also includes an explicit opt-out: any part that does not feel right to the recipient need not remain part of the story.
